::: {#exm-hadamard-code}
#### The Hadamard code with $k = 2$

List the positions $a$ in the order $00, 01, 10, 11$.
The [Hadamard code](#def-hadamard-code) sends the four messages to

- $x = 00 \mapsto 0000$,
- $x = 01 \mapsto 0101$, since $\dprod{x}{a} = a_2$,
- $x = 10 \mapsto 0011$, since $\dprod{x}{a} = a_1$,
- $x = 11 \mapsto 0110$, since $\dprod{x}{a} = a_1 + a_2 \pmod 2$.

Every nonzero codeword has weight 2, which is $2^{k-1}$,
as @thm-hadamard-distance says.

:::
